name: Metal Skin
body:
School transmutation [metal]; Level bloodlord 5, bloodrager 4, magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range touch

Target creature touched

Duration 1 min./level

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

Metal: Spells with this descriptor include those that directly create, utilize, or manipulate metal in some manner or conjure creatures composed of metal. Such spells are considered to belong to the Metal element (for geomancers) and the metal elemental school (for metal elementalists).

The subject’s skin turns into segmented metal plates.

They gain an enhancement bonus to their natural armor of +8. A creature with no natural armor is considered a +0. The target takes a -2 penalty to Dexterity. This skin also imposes an arcane spell failure chance of 20%. This cannot be cast on creatures already composed of metal.
